get_root_dir: get the root Mephisto installation directory path from the current file location
get_root_data_dir: get the configured Mephisto data storage directory with interactive setup and migration support
get_dir_for_run: get the data directory path for a specific Mephisto task run by project name and run ID
get_dir_for_task: get the directory path for a named Mephisto task from the user tasks directory
get_run_file_dir: get the absolute directory path of the currently executing Python run file
